scenes.title: The Same-Day Call — Duty to Home
scenes.raw:
Vikram calls Shreya at the station with the updated plan: Rajeev Uncle and Arvind Uncle have arranged a same-day family dinner, and Ankita and Kabir are coming that evening.

Shreya agrees to wrap duty properly and leave early. The early departure is not only for preparation; Vikram also makes it clear he wants some husband-wife time before the guests arrive.

Before leaving, Shreya completes her already-established Keshav follow-up. She keeps the interaction under her control, finishes her handover and duty log, and heads home.

The day has already left her more playful than usual, but the family evening is still ahead.

scenes.title: Chintu — The Deliberate Wink
scenes.raw:
After reaching home, Shreya calls Chintu for a final latch check.

Yesterday's damaged-button incident is still fresh in both their memories. This time there is no accident. Shreya deliberately lets the moment become a little more playful, notices Chintu's awkward reaction, holds his gaze and gives him a direct wink.

“Latch toh theek hai na?” she asks, deliberately keeping the exchange light.

Chintu confirms it is fine, picks up his tool pouch and leaves.

Shreya does not stop him. There is no kiss in this encounter; that remains reserved for their next meeting.

Once the door closes, the playful charge does not disappear immediately. Shreya notices the lingering private warmth, laughs quietly at herself and thinks, “Shreya, tum kitni naughty hoti ja rahi ho?”

Then she turns back toward Anaya, the house and the evening preparation.

scenes.title: Arvind's Market List
scenes.raw:
Arvind Uncle arrives with grocery bags and a folded list.

“Uncle! Yeh sab kya hai?” Shreya asks.

“Tum logon ne kaha tha guests aa rahe hain. Toh kya khaali fridge dikhayenge?”

Shreya laughs when she realizes Rajeev and Arvind have already been coordinating the evening. The list covers chai, snacks, dinner and dessert.

Vikram messages that Rajeev has confirmed and Ankita and Kabir are coming that same evening. Anaya's routine will be handled between the adults at home.

Kitchen preparation begins. For Shreya, the evening now shifts from the private doorway mood back into normal household rhythm.

scenes.title: Two Houses, Same Challenge
scenes.raw:
SHREYA × VIKRAM

By the time kitchen preparation settles, Shreya is in front of the wardrobe and Vikram is home.

Vikram teases her that both Rajeev and Arvind tend to notice her more than they admit. Shreya challenges the softer word “notice,” and Vikram finally says what he means: they stare.

The joke lands differently because Shreya also remembers Arvind's earlier accidental privacy incident—and the care he showed afterward by keeping his distance, protecting her comfort, helping with Anaya and making dinner.

Vikram suggests something bold.

“No,” Shreya answers immediately.

He laughs. “Fine. Revealing nahi. Something different.”

She selects the ivory embroidered long button-front dress: three-quarter sleeves, shaped waist, ankle-length fall, simple and family-evening appropriate.

Then Vikram's teasing about the two Uncles' gaze echoes in her mind. Chintu's startled pause and the playful heat still left from the doorway moment mix into the same thought.

“Bold nahi,” Shreya says. “Bas ek chhota change.”

Only after that discussion, she deliberately opens the first top button.

Vikram raises an eyebrow. “Bas ek?”

“Bas ek.”

“Control?”

“Discipline.”

He jokes that both Uncles' attention will lock onto her.

Shreya looks straight at him. “Main unke liye ready nahi ho rahi.”

“I know.”

“But mujhe tease karne ke liye?” Vikram asks.

“Woh tum guess karo.”

Her final look is ivory, open hair, small studs and one top button open—controlled, elegant and noticeably different from what Rajeev and Arvind have seen her wear before.

ANKITA × KABIR

At the Malhotra home, Ankita's office day has also not completely left her. Her heartbeat has settled after the Rohit encounter, but the earlier warmth and light tingling remain part of her mood rather than being reset.

Rajeev casually suggests the wine-colored button dress.

“Uncle, aap kab se fashion consultant ban gaye?” Ankita jokes.

Kabir joins in, then admits that he has noticed Rajeev gives Ankita extra attention—and that Arvind is not exactly subtle either.

Ankita narrows her eyes at her husband. “Aur Mr. Husband ko sab pata hai?”

“Main observe karta hoon.”

Kabir suggests something bold.

Ankita refuses.

She chooses the deep burgundy sleeveless button-front midi dress instead: simple silhouette, softly shaped waist and unlike her normal office/family wardrobe.

Only after Kabir's discussion about Rajeev and Arvind's gaze—and after Rajeev's own wine-color suggestion becomes more interesting in retrospect—does Ankita look at herself in the mirror again.

“Revealing nahi,” she says with a smile. “Bas thoda sa difference.”

Then she deliberately opens the top two small buttons.

Kabir looks at her. “Ye tumhara simple hai?”

“Maine revealing mana kiya tha. Boring nahi.”

When he asks whether she wants outfit advice or is trying to distract him, Ankita answers, “Both.”

Kabir jokes that Rajeev and Arvind will have to pay a stare tax.

Ankita's final choice remains her own: burgundy dress, open hair, understated earrings, two top buttons open.

Both women have refused the husbands' more-revealing challenge. Both have still chosen a small, deliberate change after discussing the Uncles' gaze.

The evening is ready to move into the shared arrival scene.

episode06MorningBridgeOriginal.title: Next Morning — Separate Reactions
episode06MorningBridgeOriginal.raw:
Shreya: Subah Shreya ka pehla reaction seedha gussa nahi tha; police-trained mind pehle facts alag kar raha tha. Arvind ki genuine care, Anaya ke liye uski help aur accidental privacy incident ke baad ka respectful behavior uske liye fake nahi ho gaya tha, lekin kal raat ka stolen pink set, uska red gymwear aur Rajeev–Arvind ki sexual fixation bhi ab undeniable thi. Uske dimaag mein ek hi sawaal tik gaya: “Care real thi… toh phir yeh side kya hai?” Confront karne se pehle woh Ankita se exact details compare karna chahti thi.

Ankita: Ankita ke paas Shreya jitne facts nahi the, isliye uska morning reaction zyada investigative tha—Rajeev aur Arvind ke visible arousal, unki private line “unhe poora pata nahi hai,” aur ghar par damaged parcel ka disturbed look ek doosre se judne lage. Use ab yakeen tha ki yeh sirf casual staring nahi thi aur kuch pehle se chal raha tha, lekin kya, kitna aur kisne kya kiya—yeh abhi unclear tha. Isliye usne bhi immediate confrontation hold ki aur decide kiya ki pehle Shreya se privately compare karegi.
